input.quote: ii) assist in the transfer of MSL responsibilities and Products as described in Attachment 1: Statement Of Work, to IBM or to another party that IBM designates.
input.rationale: A usable exit/transition and data-return regime already exists and runs in our favour, so no insert is needed. Section 5.2 a) ii (p0129) obliges MSL, on expiration or termination, to assist in transferring MSL's responsibilities and Products to IBM or any party IBM designates, with no time cap on that assistance — this equals or exceeds the preferred 6-month / fallback 90-day transition-assistance position. Section 5.2 a) iii (p0130) requires MSL, within a stated number of days after expiration or termination, to return to IBM all copies of IBM Product documentation and all confidential documents, discs, tapes and other media containing IBM confidential information, satisfying the data-return limb; Section 13.2 c) (p0204) additionally lets IBM demand immediate return of all confidential information at any time during the term. Attachment 6 §3(a) (p1435) adds return plus signed written certification for MS Software Image media and documentation. Nothing approaches walk-away territory: there is no immediate-deletion or no-return term. Minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording, noted but not flagged: the return period in p0130 and p1435 is redacted ([*] days) rather than expressly 30 days; there is no "commonly used, machine-readable format" specification; and the deletion-and-certification mechanic is limited to MS Software Images rather than all IBM data. Consistent with the fact that this is a 1998 manufacturing/fulfilment outsourcing rather than a hosting arrangement, and given the wind-down machinery in 5.2/5.3 and IBM's asset-purchase option in 8.0 e), these gaps do not justify a redline.
